name: Commenter AI
tagline: AI sales conversation prioritization across LinkedIn, Gmail, and Google Calendar.
description: Commenter AI helps founders, AEs, and recruiters running many active deals. It ranks revenue conversations by context, timing, next steps, and meeting signals — so the right threads get attention first.

coverImage.alt: Commenter AI Active Conversations list with prioritized leads and clients

screenshots.alt: Commenter AI conversation list showing status, ownership, and next-step context
Commenter AI conversation workspace with AI reply drafting, deal context, and reminders

problem: Sellers juggling 10+ deals jump between LinkedIn, Gmail, and Calendar. The loudest thread wins, quiet buyers slip, and half-won deals stall.
approach: Connect the channels sellers already use, label revenue conversations once, then rank what needs attention today — without forcing a full CRM workflow.
solution: A prioritization product with a daily ordered conversation list, deal context and ownership, and AI-assisted drafting when the user chooses to reply faster.
features: LinkedIn + Gmail + Google Calendar in one prioritized view
Revenue conversation labeling separate from inbox noise
Ranking by context, timing, next steps, and meeting signals
Clear ownership of who owes the next move
AI drafting for comments and DMs without auto-send
architecture: Integration-heavy AI product: OAuth-connected messaging and calendar sources feed a ranking and context layer with drafting helpers in the conversation workspace.
